request: 能修改一下把docker编译的速度提高一下吗，现在太慢了
initial_status: The isolated worktree started clean at the recorded main revision. The active checkout had pre-existing local changes in the Docker build path.
acceptance: Compare warm incremental Docker builds on the same BuildKit builder after an Office Python source edit and after changing only build identity metadata.
Reuse the runtime system-package and host-helper layers across application edits. Reuse verification and host-helper layers when only the build identity changes.
Preserve the release test gate, runtime assets, non-root permissions and startup behavior.
scope: Main and local Dockerfiles, with matching runtime asset and LAN launcher checks.
Isolated build timing and smoke validation. Keep the running Aide image and persistent data in place.

requirements.summary: The user requested faster Docker builds. This change targets warm rebuilds during normal source development.

design.summary: Keep the system package steps before frequently changing application assets. Build the cross-platform LAN and local-mount helpers from their own Go inputs. Apply version and commit metadata after source validation so the linker can update the binary without rerunning validation.

implementation.summary: Both Dockerfiles use the isolated host-helper stage and keep the AIDE_RUN_TESTS=1 release gate. Runtime asset checks now follow the new stage. The active-checkout variant preserves pre-existing local edits.

verification.summary: On the same desktop-linux BuildKit builder, warm cache-only runs took 47.12 s before and 3.78 s after an Office Python source edit, and 6.59 s before and 5.40 s after a metadata-only edit. The candidate reused the LibreOffice and host-helper layers, and also reused Go validation for the metadata-only change. BuildKit accepted the local Dockerfile. The loaded ARM64 candidate passed isolated health and offline runtime assets as UID 1000, including 153 readable files and a DOCX round trip. The LAN launcher suite passed 10 tests and the runtime asset build-input check passed. Timings cover warm cache-only builds and exclude image export. Full Go release tests, a loaded local-Dockerfile image, and a new AMD64 image were outside this verification.

documentation.summary: This record documents the cache layout, the benchmark conditions, the exact smoke-tested image and the release scope.

cleanup.summary: The isolated smoke image and 57 benchmark cache entries were removed. The raw logs and active-checkout comparison are retained locally. Daily Aide remained healthy on its existing image throughout the isolated work.

release.summary: Local source handoff only. The isolated smoke image was sha256:a25a99115135eccf2d9da273d41034282997c992dd4c3917dbb9dfe478842ef4.

release_authorization: The current request covers source changes and isolated verification. This handoff is limited to a local commit.
rollback: Revert this source commit if needed. Keep the active checkout's pre-existing edits when undoing its equivalent patch. Daily Aide kept its original running image and persistent data.
handoff: Use the local branch for source review. The timing comparison is for the main Dockerfile on one warm ARM64 builder. The raw evidence is in .agent-state/docker-build-cache/.
